title: Stockfish, But It Randomly Picks 1 of 3 Top Moves
summary: 'Random Fish': Stockfish randomly plays one of its top three engine moves. Player (white, e4) exploits it by capturing pieces that have only one recapture so that 2 of 3 candidate moves fail to recapture; wins a knight, then a free rook, and mates with Qd7/Qf7 to win game 1.
rules: Each bot move: choose uniformly at random among the engine's top 3 moves (1/3 each).
If fewer than 3 legal moves exist, choose uniformly among those available (video 2:58: with only 2 legal moves it picks between them).
win_condition: Checkmate the bot. Video: won game 1.
